lastSessionSummary: Session 12 (2026-07-29): Full multi-agent code review of app + backend before resuming dev. Found 3 features marked complete that are not actually wired up (IAP purchase flow, push token registration, background location), a guaranteed zod v4 crash in 2 screens, and multiple critical backend security holes (client-writable membership_tier, spoofable accept_connection_request, unauthenticated Edge Functions acting as an open mail relay, off-the-grid bypass, 2 tables with no RLS). Added Phase 5A (Security Hardening) and 5B (Wire Up Unfinished Features) as launch blockers; reopened the Phase 4/5 gate tests that were marked complete by code inspection rather than device testing.
nextSteps: Phase 5B first: fix the zod crash, then wire the IAP purchase flow (nobody can pay today)
Phase 5B: mount usePushNotifications and wire or delete backgroundLocation
Phase 5A: close the critical RLS and Edge Function holes before any real users
Install the dev client and device test on iOS simulator + the new Google Pixel
Android Cross-Platform Pass — now unblocked, Pixel available
openQuestions: Social auth (Google/Facebook) deferred — needs dev build + provider config
GradientBackground permanently dropped — solid #0F2419 on auth screens
Phase 4/5 were marked complete via code inspection; treat any remaining 'code verified' gate test as unproven until device tested
Decide whether background location ships at all — it is currently dead code and adds an App Store privacy burden
RevenueCat tier sync must move to a server-side webhook; decide the Edge Function shape

Fix accept_connection_request(request_id, caller_id) — derive identity from auth.uid(), drop the spoofable overload
Enforce basic-tier 8-connection limit server-side in the overload the client actually calls
Require caller authentication in all 3 Edge Functions (verify JWT + authorize the specific action)
Add supabase/config.toml with explicit verify_jwt settings for Edge Functions
HTML-escape all user input interpolated into Resend templates (send-invite-email, send-support-email)
Add rate limiting to all 3 Edge Functions
Restrict send-push-notification — verify caller is a real participant and honor user_notification_settings
Enable RLS + policies on parental_settings and support_messages (currently no RLS at all)
Fix user_location_settings SELECT policy to honor is_off_the_grid, sharing_enabled, share_with_connections
Stop returning exact distance alongside jittered coordinates in get_nearby_users (trilateration risk)
Validate caller coordinates in get_nearby_users against stored location (prevent location spoofing/sweeping)
Tighten open INSERT policies: families, family_invites, conversations, conversation_participants
REVOKE EXECUTE on SECURITY DEFINER functions from PUBLIC/anon; grant only to authenticated
Restrict user_profiles SELECT — stop exposing phone_number and last_name to every authenticated user
Harden handle_new_auth_user trigger against null/duplicate email (currently can hard-fail signup)
Add unique constraint on connection_requests(from_user_id, to_user_id) + DELETE policy to cancel
